verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of Vercel's native storage/database bindings (e.g. Postgres, KV, Blob) or an integrations marketplace that would deliver 'minimal boilerplate' connections to external services; the closest docs mention are vague AI-agent tool creation, not credential/binding automation. A community report explicitly states that securely connecting Vercel to a database beyond a password requires contacting enterprise sales, undermining any claim of frictionless native bindings. missing for 10: docs on Vercel Storage/KV/Postgres/Blob, an integrations marketplace, or automatic env-var/credential injection for third-party services; independent hands-on confirmation that bindings reduce boilerplate.
